title: Zesty Crispy Slovakian Crustaceans Empanadas
description: A citrusy, crispy Slovakian dish featuring crustaceans, wrapped in pandan leaves, perfect for a sick day, this sugar-free-friendly empanada is a unique twist on traditional cuisine. The combination of flavors and textures will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the garlic and onion to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the shrimp to the skillet and cook until they are pink and fully cooked.
In a large bowl, whisk together the almond flour, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked shrimp mixture to the bowl and stir until everything is well combined.
Lay a pandan leaf flat on a work surface and place a tablespoon of the shrimp mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the leaf over the filling to form a triangle and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush the tops with lemon juice.
Bake the empanadas in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until they are crispy and golden brown.
